limits: For white wine, Pinot Blanc: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
land: Faces the midday sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

blurb.text: A large Grand Cru hill in the Côte de Beaune, shared by Aloxe-Corton, Pernand-Vergelesses and Ladoix, making red and white wine. Labels usually add the climat name, as in Corton Les Bressandes. Reds use Pinot Noir and whites use Chardonnay.
